{{Current events|year=2019|month=08|day=19|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]; [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present)#Syrian airstrike on Turkish military convoy|2019 Northwestern Syria offensive]]
**[[Syrian Air Force]] warplanes repeatedly strike a [[Turkish military]] convoy driving through the rebel-held region of [[Idlib Governorate|Idlib]], reportedly causing several casualties and forcing it to stop. Turkey claims the convoy was aiming to supply observation posts, while Syria accuses it of carrying weapons and ammunition to rebel groups. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49394759 (BBC)] [https://www.thenational.ae/world/mena/turkish-army-convoy-in-syria-s-idlib-targeted-by-airstrikes-1.900045 (The National)]
**The [[Syrian Army]] enters the strategic town of [[Khan Shaykhun]] in the [[Idlib Governorate]] for the first time since losing control of the town to rebels in 2014, according to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20190819-syria-fierce-battles-as-assads-forces-enter-khan-sheikhoun/ (''Middle East Monitor'')]

;Arts and culture
*The biggest multi-storey [[bicycle parking]] in the world, with a capacity of 12,500 bikes, opens near [[Utrecht Centraal railway station]], the [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.smartcitiesworld.net/news/news/utrecht-becomes-home-to-worlds-largest-bike-park-4491 (SmartCitiesWorld)] [https://www.theguardian.com/cities/2019/aug/19/dutch-take-cycling-to-a-new-level-with-worlds-biggest-bike-park (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Deforestation in Brazil]]
**After fifteen days of raging fires in the [[Amazon Forest]] in [[Rondônia]], thick smoke clouds cover the [[Brazil|Brazilian]] city of [[São Paulo]] in darkness. Street lamps had to be lit in the city around 2PM. The fires, suspected to be intentional, are still burning the forest. [https://g1.globo.com/sp/sao-paulo/noticia/2019/08/19/dia-vira-noite-em-sao-paulo-com-chegada-de-frente-fria-nesta-segunda.ghtml (G1)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests]]; [[Cross-Strait relations]]
**[[China]] condemns [[Taiwan]] after [[President of the Republic of China|President]] [[Tsai Ing-wen]] offered support and [[right of asylum|asylum]] to [[Hong Kong]] protesters facing prosecution in Hong Kong courts. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2019/08/19/China-lashes-Taiwan-over-offer-to-Hong-Kong-protesters-.html# (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Twitter]] says it has suspended more than 200,000 automated accounts on the [[social media]] site that it believes were part of a [[China|Chinese]] government-run campaign to spread misinformation about the [[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests|protests]] in [[Hong Kong]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/twitter-shuts-chinese-accounts-targeting-hong-kong-protests-65060958 (ABC News)] 

;Law and crime
*[[2016–present purges in Turkey]]
**[[Ministry of the Interior (Turkey)|Turkey's Ministry of the Interior]] tweets that 418 people in 29 provinces are detained by police, for suspected links with the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party|Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK)]]. The authorities have also announced that they "replaced" the mayors of three major southeastern cities. [https://www.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKCN1V90EX (Reuters)]
*Former [[President of Sudan]] [[Omar al-Bashir]] appears in court for the first time at a [[Khartoum]] court to face corruption charges. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/08/19/Sudan-s-Bashir-in-court-for-graft-trial.html (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Human rights in El Salvador#Women|Women's rights in El Salvador]]
**Evelyn Hernández is acquitted of murder after her newly-born child was found deceased in a toilet. The ruling is being held as a landmark case decision for women's rights in El Salvador, which has one of the strongest anti-abortion laws in Central America. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49368632 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
* The [[Palestinian Authority]] bans [[LGBT rights in the State of Palestine|LGBT activities]] in the [[West Bank]] in anticipation of an upcoming [[Al Qaws]] event. [https://www.jpost.com/Middle-East/PA-bans-LGBT-activities-in-West-Bank-598980 (''Jerusalem Post'')]

;Science and technology
*Astronomers led by a team from [[McGill University]] in [[Montreal]] announce the detection of eight new repeating [[fast radio burst]]s (FRBs) using the [[Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment]] (CHIME) [[radio telescope]]. The astronomers report they also found complex morphologies and downward-drifting sub-bursts in some of the eight new FRBs. [https://phys.org/news/2019-08-fast-radio.html (Phys.org)]
